description.en:
Reads the match flag written by CMND_BTL_SET_NOT_FORCE_FAUL_FLAG.
The match also keeps the flag up to date on its own: while it updates the pitch display, it sets it to 1 when either team's goalkeeper is in the forced-win list (CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN), and to 0 when neither is. So during a match it mostly tells whether a goalkeeper is under a forced win.
No shipped script calls it.

true if the flag is set, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Checking the flag before a scripted beat (not found in script_clean/; invented)
